# cloudsandai

> Foundations-first, instructor-led education in mathematics, statistical methods and machine learning, with programming and scientific computing integrated throughout. Founded and taught by Deven Dande in Nagpur, India, with online learning options.

## About

cloudsandai is an independent educational initiative led by Deven Dande and a team of 3+ AI engineers. It is designed for engineering students, polytechnic students, recent graduates, working professionals, and learners who want to understand AI and machine learning beyond surface-level tools and buzzwords.

The initiative's primary purpose is to respond to a problem Deven sees in the AI education market: many bootcamps market AI/ML as a gimmick, make ambitious promises, and enroll students without developing the mathematical and statistical understanding, computational thinking, and programming practice needed for genuine understanding. cloudsandai takes the opposite approach by developing foundations first and connecting theory to implementation.

A second purpose is to democratize AI/ML education for non-English-speaking audiences. Deven plans to make explanations and learning resources available in Hindi as well, so language is less of a barrier for students who want to learn AI and machine learning.

Deven and his team have AWS certifications and hands-on experience delivering AI/ML projects and proofs of concept for clients across India, the UK, the USA, and government sectors. For the past three years, the team has conducted AI/ML internships and training programs for polytechnic and engineering students in Nagpur, with more than 200 students reached.

## Learning Approach

- Build mathematical intuition instead of treating algorithms as black boxes.
- Develop probability, statistics, estimation, testing, and statistical modelling skills.
- Study classical machine learning algorithms and the complete machine learning workflow.
- Use Python, algorithms, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, data analysis, visualization, and scientific computing throughout the academic curriculum.
- Translate mathematical equations into working implementations and computational experiments.
- Progress from machine-learning foundations into practical AI application development.
- Combine instructor-led explanation with programming and implementation sessions.

## Courses

### AI/ML Foundations

Beginner-focused, 16-week course covering Python and scientific computing, mathematics for machine learning, probability and statistics, machine learning fundamentals, an introduction to deep learning, and one guided capstone project. Programming and implementation are integrated throughout.

### AI Engineering

Application-focused, 16-week course for learners with Python proficiency. Topics include LLM fundamentals, hosted and open-source models, APIs and FastAPI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI workflows, and AWS deployment. Every student completes all three guided, assessed projects, choosing one instructor-approved application in each category: Knowledge-Grounded AI (for example, a Document Intelligence Assistant, academic handbook assistant, technical documentation assistant, or company policy assistant); Multimodal AI (for example, a Speech and Translation Assistant, lecture companion, meeting summarizer, or image-and-text understanding application); and Agentic AI (for example, a Booking Workflow Agent, customer-support triage, order-status assistant, or appointment scheduling agent).

## Curriculum

### Mathematical Foundations for Machine Learning

The essential mathematical tools used in the machine-learning modules: vectors and matrices, matrix multiplication, dot products, distances and similarity, derivatives and gradients, the chain rule, loss functions, gradient descent, stochastic gradient descent, and learning rates.

### Introduction to Statistical Methods

Descriptive statistics (mean, median, variance, and standard deviation), basic and conditional probability, independence, Bayes rule, random variables, expectation, variance, covariance, and Bernoulli and Gaussian distributions.

### Machine Learning

Machine-learning workflow, data preparation, model training and evaluation, regression and classification, decision trees, nearest neighbors, support vector machines, Bayesian learning, ensemble learning, clustering, and model evaluation including bias, fairness, and interpretability.

### Introduction to Deep Learning

An introduction to neurons, layers and weights, forward propagation, activation and loss functions, gradient descent and backpropagation, overfitting and regularization, and common deep-learning applications. CNNs, recurrent networks, and transformers are not part of this introductory module.

### Integrated Programming & Implementation

Programming is not taught as a separate subject. It is used throughout the curriculum to turn mathematical and statistical concepts into working implementations and experiments. Learn the concept, code it, experiment with it, and understand it. Topics include Python syntax, data types, conditionals, loops, functions, modules, debugging, problem solving, recursion, computational thinking, code organization, complexity, data structures, searching, sorting, algorithms, NumPy, vectorization, broadcasting, matrix operations, numerical differentiation and integration, simulation, numerical optimization, Pandas, Matplotlib, data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, visualization, and machine learning implementation.

## Free Educational Content

Deven Dande will soon publish free AI/ML explanation videos through the cloudsandai website, YouTube, and Instagram. These explanations are intended to make foundational AI/ML concepts more accessible, including for Hindi-speaking learners. The YouTube channel link will be added to the website when it is available.

## Audience and Delivery

- Engineering students
- Polytechnic students
- Recent graduates
- Working professionals
- Learners preparing for practical AI/ML work
- Students seeking mathematics and programming foundations before deep learning

Teaching is instructor-led and available in Nagpur, India, with online options. Contact Deven for current batch schedules, enrollment, and delivery details.
